skill_name: Compare and contrast the concept of food deserts with food swamps
workflow: Food deserts and food swamps are both terms that refer to the geographic availability of healthful foods. Food deserts describe areas where there is limited availability of healthful foods due to their high cost or lack of access. Food swamps refer to areas where there is easy access to less healthful, more processed and fast foods, often at a lower cost.
